A flexible body cannot keep its pose.
A key slot can move this axis while a si: A key slot can move this axis while a simulation runs. An axis has at most one binding; one slot may serve several. Bindings are saved with the model and can be changed only while no simulation runs. Virtual controls are bound on their cards in the control panel.
A name for what this slot operates, for: A name for what this slot operates, for example "Gripper". It is saved in the settings for every model and shown next to the slot number.
A profile is a saved set of body and axi: A profile is a saved set of body and axis values. Applying it copies the values onto a body; the body keeps them until you sync it again.
A servo holds a position, a motor holds: A servo holds a position, a motor holds a speed. Max. force, load and contacts decide what the body actually reaches.
A virtual control moves several axes wit: A virtual control moves several axes with one switch or slider, for example "Flap: closed / open". Each state sets a target for every axis in the control; a slider moves smoothly from state to state. Axes in a virtual control have no control of their own in the control panel. Virtual controls are saved with the model and can be changed only while no simulation runs.
Acceleration along the model's Z axis in: Acceleration along the model's Z axis in m/s². −9.81 is Earth's gravity, 0 makes all bodies weightless and positive values pull upwards. Stronger gravity means more load for actuators.
Actuated bodies must use their controls.
Adds a slot after the last one or remove: Adds a slot after the last one or removes the last one, at once. Removing a slot also clears its key and label. Bindings that refer to a slot that no longer exists are skipped at Start, not deleted.
Adds an invisible floor at Z = 0 for thi: Adds an invisible floor at Z = 0 for this body.
Adds an invisible, infinite floor at hei: Adds an invisible, infinite floor at height Z = 0 for bodies to land on. Switch it off when parts should move below Z = 0 or when the model has its own base.
An optional second slot that subtracts t: An optional second slot that subtracts the step.
At Start, the control panel lists movabl: At Start, the control panel lists movable bodies that reach below Z = 0 while ground contact is on: they scrape along the ground and distort the result. Bodies that only rest on Z = 0, fixed bodies and bodies without ground contact are not listed. The warning never prevents the start.
Attachment body is missing or refers to: Attachment body is missing or refers to itself.
Attraction pulls other bodies towards th: Attraction pulls other bodies towards this one. With a sideways start velocity it makes an orbit.
Automatic setup is disabled in this buil: Automatic setup is disabled in this build. Follow the {link}.
Ball joint turns freely in every directi: Ball joint turns freely in every direction. Pin joint turns around one axis. Fixed connection allows no movement.
Both bodies must participate in the simu: Both bodies must participate in the simulation.
Box and Sphere are simple shapes. Convex: Box and Sphere are simple shapes. Convex hull wraps the body like cling film and fills dents and holes. Child components use each part on its own, so openings stay open.
Cable is too stiff for this resolution. Reduce stiffness or use fewer segments.
Choose a clamped or pinned start before: Choose a clamped or pinned start before assigning a reference body.
Clamped holds the start end fixed. Pinne: Clamped holds the start end fixed. Pinned holds it in place but lets it swing. Free does not hold it.
Collision shapes are the simplified geom: Collision shapes are the simplified geometry Newton uses for contact: a box, a sphere or a convex hull around each body. They appear as coloured outlines over the model and reveal where contact geometry differs from what you see. This option decides whether the display is on when a window opens; the menu command “Show collision shapes” switches it in the current window. The display never changes how bodies collide.
Compound collision needs child groups or: Compound collision needs child groups or components.
Copies a saved set of body and axis valu: Copies a saved set of body and axis values onto this body.
Copy the profile's values onto this body: Copy the profile's values onto this body again. Placement and reference body stay.
Could not inspect collision shapes. Chec: Could not inspect collision shapes. Check the Newton Runtime.
Coupled axes have no shared travel.
Coupled axis is missing or refers to its: Coupled axis is missing or refers to itself.
Coupling chains and cycles are not suppo: Coupling chains and cycles are not supported.
Creates the runtime in your IngeTrazo da: Creates the runtime in your IngeTrazo data folder: a private Python 3.12 and MuJoCo 3.3.7. It starts only when you confirm. Remove runtime is offered only for a runtime created this way and deletes only that folder.
Defaults for every simulation. They take: Defaults for every simulation. They take effect the next time you press Start and apply to all bodies that do not use their own simulation settings.
Document changed. Pick the reference bod: Document changed. Pick the reference body again.
Document changed. Place the axis again.
Drag passive bodies with the mouse. Move: Drag passive bodies with the mouse. Move actuators with the controls.
Each axis starts when the previous one h: Each axis starts when the previous one has reached its target, in the order of the table rows. Off: all axes start together.
Fall acceleration for this body. Z = −9.81 is Earth; all three at 0 make it weightless. It still pulls on connected bodies.
Fixed or actuated body. Use the controls: Fixed or actuated body. Use the controls.
Flexible bodies cannot also have a motio: Flexible bodies cannot also have a motion axis.
Follow the {link} to set up Python and M: Follow the {link} to set up Python and MuJoCo yourself.
Free: nothing drives the axis. Servo: mo: Free: nothing drives the axis. Servo: moves to a target position. Motor: runs at a target speed.
Grey values are inherited from the globa: Grey values are inherited from the global settings. Change a value to use it for this body only; the button next to it resets it.
Hidden groups and groups on hidden layer: Hidden groups and groups on hidden layers. When needed simulates a hidden body only if a visible body depends on it, for example as its reference body, attachment, connection or coupling, and keeps hidden static bodies as surroundings. All other hidden bodies are left out, so large models start faster. Always simulates every hidden body; Never leaves all of them out.
How exactly joints and contacts are solv: How exactly joints and contacts are solved. Quick suits setting up large mechanisms, Balanced everyday work, and Precise checking demanding contacts. Geometry and cable resolution stay the same, but motion can differ slightly between the levels.
How far the axis may move either way fro: How far the axis may move either way from where you placed it. Zero is the placed position.
How far this axis moves when the followe: How far this axis moves when the followed axis moves 1. 2 means twice as far.
How hard the stops are. 100 % is a solid: How hard the stops are. 100 % is a solid stop; lower values give way under load like a rubber buffer.
How heavy the body is. Heavier parts nee: How heavy the body is. Heavier parts need stronger actuators.
How much the body springs back after a h: How much the body springs back after a hit. 0 means none; the result is approximate.
How quickly the axis gets up to speed.
How quickly the axis slows down.
How strongly the strand resists bending. Rope and Cable set typical values.
How strongly the strand resists twisting: How strongly the strand resists twisting.
How strongly this body pulls other bodie: How strongly this body pulls other bodies towards it. 0 means no pull.
How well surfaces grip. 0 is like ice.
In sync: same as the profile. Local chan: In sync: same as the profile. Local changes: this body differs from it. Profile changed: the profile was edited since.
Initial velocity needs a freely movable: Initial velocity needs a freely movable body.
Invalid control target or unknown joint.
Joins this body to another at a point, f: Joins this body to another at a point, for example a connecting rod to a slider. The joint must not block the motion of your axes.
Joint cycle detected. Closed chains are: Joint cycle detected. Closed chains are not supported.
Joint limits must include the initial po: Joint limits must include the initial position.
Keep warnings and errors on reset: Keep warnings and errors on reset
Keeps the values but stops tracking the: Keeps the values but stops tracking the profile.
Key slots are commands that bindings in: Key slots are commands that bindings in the control panel can use to move actuators and virtual controls with the keyboard. A label (for example "Gripper") is shown with the slot in IngeTrazo's shortcut settings and in the bindings. Assign… opens IngeTrazo's shortcut settings at the slot; no key is assigned by default. A slot only reacts while a simulation runs, so its key stays free for modelling.
Label: Label
Lets this body pass through the bodies y: Lets this body pass through the bodies you pick, for example a pin inside its bearing that would otherwise jam. Their joint must then guide them; other contacts stay.
Like linear damping, but for rotation: s: Like linear damping, but for rotation: slows down spinning and wobbling bodies. 0 switches it off.
Limit hardness must be between 0 and 100: Limit hardness must be between 0 and 100 %.
Locks the axis object in the model so th: Locks the axis object in the model so that no tool moves or rotates it by accident. It still follows its body.
Locks the connection object in the model: Locks the connection object in the model so that no tool moves or rotates it by accident. It still follows its body.
Makes this axis follow another one, for: Makes this axis follow another one, for example two gripper jaws moved by one control. The limits of both axes apply.
Mass, friction and bounce decide how thi: Mass, friction and bounce decide how this body reacts to forces and contacts. Heavier bodies need more actuator force.
Model geometry cannot be deleted during: Model geometry cannot be deleted during the simulation. Reset the simulation first.
Movable bodies move under gravity and fo: Movable bodies move under gravity and forces. Fixed bodies stay put but others can touch them. Excluded bodies are left out completely.
Move the axes one after another: Move the axes one after another
Name: Name
Newton uses a simple shape for contacts,: Newton uses a simple shape for contacts, not your exact model. Pick the shape that fits the body best.
Newton will download uv {uv} and Python: Newton will download uv {uv} and Python {python}, install MuJoCo {mujoco} into {folder} and test it. Nothing else on your computer is changed. Continue?
No Newton runtime was found. Set it up u: No Newton runtime was found. Set it up under Preferences > Newton > Runtime.
No movable bodies. Select a body and mak: No movable bodies. Select a body and make it movable.
Only servo axes of the same kind (rotati: Only servo axes of the same kind (rotation or linear) can be followed.
Opens IngeTrazo's shortcut settings at t: Opens IngeTrazo's shortcut settings at the command that switches the collision display. No shortcut is assigned by default.
Opposite makes this axis move the other: Opposite makes this axis move the other way, as with two gripper jaws.
Optionally attaches the other end to a b: Optionally attaches the other end to a body.
Pick the 0° direction, X/Y/Z, or Enter t: Pick the 0° direction, X/Y/Z, or Enter to keep it.
Pick the body that should pass through t: Pick the body that should pass through this body. Esc cancels.
Pick the connection point. Esc cancels.
Pick the direction or press X/Y/Z.
Pick the origin, then a direction or X/Y: Pick the origin, then a direction or X/Y/Z. Esc cancels.
Pick the other body. Esc cancels.
Pick the pin direction or press X/Y/Z.
Pick the reference body. Esc cancels.
Place an axis on each linked body before: Place an axis on each linked body before syncing this profile.
Place the point and the pin direction, t: Place the point and the pin direction, then pick the other body
Place the point, then pick the other bod: Place the point, then pick the other body
Profile link queued for OK. Object value: Profile link queued for OK. Object values stay unchanged.
Reference body is missing. Reassign or d: Reference body is missing. Reassign or detach it.
Reset keeps the last warning or error in: Reset keeps the last warning or error in the control panel, with its list of bodies, instead of replacing it with the reset notice. The bodies in the list can then be selected in the model. Start always clears every message and checks again.
Reset writes the simulated position and: Reset writes the simulated position and rotation of the bodies into the model instead of restoring the original pose, as one undo step; their axes and attachments move along. Joint start angles are not changed. If a body cannot simply be moved (flexible, locked or containing groups) or the geometry changed, nothing is kept and the original model is restored. Resetting after an error never keeps the pose.
Rope bends easily, Cable is stiffer. Rig: Rope bends easily, Cable is stiffer. Rigid switches the strand off.
Select a body and place an axis.
Select a group containing one open line: Select a group containing one open line without faces.
Show collision shapes in new windows: Show collision shapes in new windows
Shows or hides the collision shape of th: Shows or hides the collision shape of this body only. The global setting in the preferences stays as it is.
Simulation became unstable. Reduce stiff: Simulation became unstable. Reduce stiffness or use fewer segments.
Simulation not ready or step count outsi: Simulation not ready or step count outside 1 to 24.
Slows down moving bodies, similar to air: Slows down moving bodies, similar to air resistance. At 1 /s a free body loses about two thirds of its speed per second; 0 switches damping off. More damping calms oscillations but also resists intended motion, so actuators need more force.
Slows the body like air resistance. 0 me: Slows the body like air resistance. 0 means no slowing.
Speed and acceleration must be positive.
Speed at the start. Only used for movabl: Speed at the start. Only used for movable bodies without an axis or reference body.
Stops the pull from becoming huge at ver: Stops the pull from becoming huge at very small distances.
Sync queued for OK. Local values will be: Sync queued for OK. Local values will be overwritten.
The Newton process did not answer within: The Newton process did not answer within 15 seconds. The simulation was reset.
The Newton process failed: {error}. The: The Newton process failed: {error}. The simulation was reset.
The Newton process reported an error wit: The Newton process reported an error without details. The simulation was reset.
The Newton process returned invalid body: The Newton process returned invalid body positions. The simulation was reset.
The Newton process stopped unexpectedly: The Newton process stopped unexpectedly (exit code {code}). The simulation was reset.
The Python interpreter of the environmen: The Python interpreter of the environment that contains MuJoCo 3.3.7. Newton runs the simulation and the collision display in it as a separate process. Change this only when that environment has been moved or replaced; editing the model never requires it. Check runtime tests the interpreter entered here.
The amount each press adds, limited to t: The amount each press adds, limited to the range the control panel offers.
The body \"{name}\" contains groups and: The body "{name}" contains groups and cannot be moved this way.
The body is hidden or locked.
The body this one hangs on. With an axis: The body this one hangs on. With an axis it moves relative to that body; without one it stays rigidly attached.
The connection axis must not be zero.
The direction the pin points along; the: The direction the pin points along; the bodies turn around it.
The geometry changed during the simulati: The geometry changed during the simulation. Check the model before saving it.
The geometry of the body \"{name}\" is i: The geometry of the body "{name}" is invalid.
The interpreter you use now, {path}, is: The interpreter you use now, {path}, is not inside this folder and stays untouched.
The joint axis must not be zero.
The key bindings of this document are da: The key bindings of this document are damaged.
The key slot that operates this control. Its key is assigned in the preferences under Key slots.
The model cannot be edited during the si: The model cannot be edited during the simulation. Reset the simulation first.
The model cannot be saved during the sim: The model cannot be saved during the simulation. Reset the simulation first.
The most force the actuator may use (tur: The most force the actuator may use (turning force on a rotation axis). If it is too low, the axis lags behind its target under load.
The name of this axis in the control pan: The name of this axis in the control panel.
The pose was not kept: {reason} The orig: The pose was not kept: {reason} The original model is restored.
The reference body is missing, hidden or: The reference body is missing, hidden or excluded from the simulation.
The reference body must be visible and p: The reference body must be visible and participate in the simulation.
The simulated pose was written into the: The simulated pose was written into the model. Undo restores the original pose.
The simulation cannot start while anothe: The simulation cannot start while another workspace is open. Close that workspace first.
The simulation was reset and the origina: The simulation was reset and the original model is restored.
The simulation workspace could not be op: The simulation workspace could not be opened, so the simulation did not start.
The value a press returns to when the co: The value a press returns to when the control is at the value above.
The virtual control “{name}” is damaged. Delete it and create it again.
The virtual controls of this document ar: The virtual controls of this document are damaged.
These bodies reach below Z = 0 and scrap: These bodies reach below Z = 0 and scrape along the ground, which distorts the result. Lift them above Z = 0 or switch off their ground contact.
Thickness of the strand. Thicker means s: Thickness of the strand. Thicker means stiffer.
This axis follows another axis. Directio: This axis follows another axis. Direction and ratio set how it moves with it; the followed axis's actuator drives both.
This reference would create a cycle.
Toggle: a press switches between two val: Toggle: a press switches between two values. Step: each press adds the step; a second slot can subtract it.
Top speed of the axis. A servo never tra: Top speed of the axis. A servo never travels faster to its target.
Turns one open line into a rope or cable: Turns one open line into a rope or cable that bends and swings. Select a group that holds just that line.
Use a centre line with 3 to 201 points.
Use the flexible material end attachment: Use the flexible material end attachments for ropes and cables.
Use this when the automatic setup is not: Use this when the automatic setup is not available or you want to keep your own Python environment. The guide covers Linux, Windows and Flatpak. Afterwards enter the interpreter under Python with MuJoCo above.
Values set here are copied to a body whe: Values set here are copied to a body when you apply this profile. Grey values stay at the global default; change a value to store it, the button next to it resets it.
Where the joint sits in the model.
Where the servo aims, or how fast the mo: Where the servo aims, or how fast the motor runs, when the simulation starts. The control panel changes it afterwards.
{bodies} follow this control. Their addi: {bodies} follow this control. Their additional load and limits also affect the leading axis; select a follower to change how far or in which direction it moves.
“{body}” belongs to two virtual controls: “{body}” belongs to two virtual controls, “{first}” and “{second}”. Remove it from one of them.
